recentItems.title: Growing push to pause AI toy sales
recentItems.description: Officials are urging for a halt on the manufacturing and sale of dolls and stuffed animals that connect to the internet and feature integrated AI.

recentItems.title: Australian cyclist rides 10,000 miles across all 48 contiguous states
recentItems.description: Ultra-cyclist Jack Thompson finished the trip in 60 days, marking his 10 years of sobriety.

recentItems.title: Macy’s parade prep underway as balloon decision looms
recentItems.description: Crews are preparing balloons and floats for the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade as officials weigh whether gusty winds will force them to fly lower or stay grounded.

recentItems.title: New video showing Kilmar Abrego Garcia self-deporting to Spain
recentItems.description: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, who was returned to the U.S. after being mistakenly deported to a Salvadoran mega-prison, is self-deporting to Spain, the Department of Homeland Security confirmed.
